title: OpenWatchlist Homelab False-Positive Archetype Corpus
source_note: Derived from 35 user-provided Fircosoft-style industry false-positive examples. The original illustrative watchlist IDs, biographies, scores, and release decisions are not qualification truth.

data_policy.watchlist_truth: frozen real OFAC source data only
data_policy.opensanctions_truth: real OpenSanctions FollowTheMoney entity cross-walked to the same OFAC source record
synthetic_forbidden: OFAC names or aliases presented as official

real_data_binding.selection_strategy: Bind a real OFAC individual whose primary name or real alias contains common given/surname tokens and has at least one secondary biographical attribute.

synthetic_transaction_recipe.recipe: Retain the strongest real name tokens in a synthetic innocent person, add a distinct token, and provide conflicting DOB, nationality, address, and typed identifier evidence.

real_data_binding.selection_strategy: Bind a real OFAC entity or alias with a short distinctive token that can be embedded inside a benign synthetic word without altering the OFAC source record.

synthetic_transaction_recipe.recipe: Embed the real token inside a synthetic business, product, or activity word and place it in a non-geographic field with clean country evidence.

real_data_binding.selection_strategy: Bind a real OFAC vessel with a distinctive primary-name token and, when available, a real IMO or flag attribute.

synthetic_transaction_recipe.recipe: Create a synthetic onshore corporation using one vessel-name token while providing corporate legal form, company address, and no vessel identifier.

real_data_binding.selection_strategy: Bind a real OFAC organization with a real short alias or distinctive 2-4 character token; do not fabricate a code when the frozen snapshot has no eligible record.

synthetic_transaction_recipe.recipe: Embed the real token in a syntactically valid synthetic BIC or routing code belonging to a clean jurisdiction.

real_data_binding.selection_strategy: Bind a real OFAC organization with a real acronym or short alias between 3 and 6 characters.

synthetic_transaction_recipe.recipe: Expand the same letters into a benign synthetic company name and provide conflicting registry country, industry, and ownership evidence.

real_data_binding.selection_strategy: Bind a real OFAC individual with multiple real aliases or transliterations plus DOB, nationality, or passport evidence.

synthetic_transaction_recipe.recipe: Generate a close phonetic spelling from the real name while assigning a conflicting synthetic DOB, country, and typed identifier.

archetypes.title: Port or Locality Name Containment Hit

real_data_binding.selection_strategy: Bind a real OFAC entity with a short locality-like or name token suitable for containment testing.

synthetic_transaction_recipe.recipe: Embed the token inside a synthetic company, complex, port, or locality name in a clean jurisdiction.

real_data_binding.selection_strategy: Bind a real OFAC organization or alias containing a token that also has ordinary commercial or dictionary use.

synthetic_transaction_recipe.recipe: Use the overlapping token in a benign synthetic commercial name or service description with conflicting business context.

real_data_binding.selection_strategy: Bind a real OFAC organization whose name contains generic trade or legal-form words plus at least one distinctive token.

synthetic_transaction_recipe.recipe: Create a synthetic company that overlaps on generic words or punctuation-normalized initials but differs on distinctive tokens, country, and registry context.

archetypes.title: OFAC Keyword Match with Missing Qualifying Words

real_data_binding.selection_strategy: Bind a real OFAC government, military, bank, ministry, or state organization whose primary name contains critical qualifying terms.

synthetic_transaction_recipe.recipe: Remove the critical real qualifying terms from a synthetic private-company name while retaining a secondary phrase cluster.

real_data_binding.selection_strategy: Bind a real OFAC individual with Cyrillic-origin name variants and real biographical or passport attributes.

synthetic_transaction_recipe.recipe: Generate a plausible alternate Latin transliteration while assigning conflicting DOB, nationality, passport country, and address.

real_data_binding.selection_strategy: Bind a real OFAC individual with compound paternal/maternal surnames and real nationality or DOB evidence.

synthetic_transaction_recipe.recipe: Reorder or partially retain the real name components in a synthetic person while changing maternal surname and secondary identifiers.

real_data_binding.selection_strategy: Bind a real OFAC individual with a short East Asian name and real nationality, address, DOB, or passport evidence.

synthetic_transaction_recipe.recipe: Use the exact real name for a synthetic innocent person but supply conflicting nationality, residency, DOB, and passport country.

real_data_binding.selection_strategy: Bind a real OFAC financial institution with a real acronym or short alias that can appear at the start of a synthetic BIC.

synthetic_transaction_recipe.recipe: Create a clean synthetic intermediary bank and BIC containing the real acronym, with conflicting country and institution identity.

real_data_binding.selection_strategy: Bind a real OFAC government or ministry record with a distinctive multi-token phrase.

synthetic_transaction_recipe.recipe: Place a normalized fragment of that phrase inside a synthetic legal, bond, infrastructure, or indemnity reference unrelated to the target.

real_data_binding.selection_strategy: Bind a real OFAC vessel, organization, or person with a short distinctive token that can be contained inside a longer synthetic vessel or cargo name.

synthetic_transaction_recipe.recipe: Embed the token in a clean synthetic vessel, product, terminal, or cargo reference and provide clean route and ownership context.

real_data_binding.selection_strategy: Bind a real OFAC organization with a real short alias suitable for deterministic reference-string collision.

synthetic_transaction_recipe.recipe: Place the real alias only inside a synthetic sender reference and ensure no party field contains the target identity.

archetypes.title: Account Number Collision with Vessel IMO

real_data_binding.selection_strategy: Bind a real OFAC vessel with a real IMO or other typed numeric asset identifier.

synthetic_transaction_recipe.recipe: Place the exact real numeric identifier in a synthetic bank-account field while omitting all vessel context.

real_data_binding.selection_strategy: Bind any real OFAC organization with a sufficiently distinctive primary name.

synthetic_transaction_recipe.recipe: Include the exact real name only inside a synthetic negative declaration such as no relationship or no involvement.

real_data_binding.selection_strategy: Bind a real OFAC financial institution or state enterprise with a distinctive prefix and real entity type.

synthetic_transaction_recipe.recipe: Create a synthetic regulated fund whose name shares the prefix but has fund legal form, clean registry jurisdiction, and distinct ownership.

real_data_binding.selection_strategy: Bind a real OFAC vessel or aircraft with a short primary-name token or real asset identifier.

synthetic_transaction_recipe.recipe: Embed the real token in a synthetic ISIN-like or alternate financial instrument identifier.

real_data_binding.selection_strategy: Bind a real OFAC organization with a real short alias or distinctive token.

synthetic_transaction_recipe.recipe: Embed the token in a synthetic consortium, agent, tranche, or facility-reference acronym with clean project geography.

real_data_binding.selection_strategy: Bind a real OFAC individual whose given and family names can plausibly appear in a synthetic company name.

synthetic_transaction_recipe.recipe: Build a synthetic registered vendor from the real name tokens and add corporate suffix, registry country, and ownership context.

archetypes.title: Corporate Liquidity Sweep Internal Code Collision

real_data_binding.selection_strategy: Bind a real OFAC organization with a real short alias or distinctive acronym.

synthetic_transaction_recipe.recipe: Embed the alias in a synthetic internal organization or treasury-pool identifier rather than a party name.

real_data_binding.selection_strategy: Bind a real OFAC entity with a distinctive token that can be segmented inside a synthetic product model or serial number.

synthetic_transaction_recipe.recipe: Create a synthetic invoice/product code containing the token and provide clean goods, origin, destination, and counterparty context.

archetypes.title: Middle Eastern Name Transliteration and Age Conflict

real_data_binding.selection_strategy: Bind a real OFAC individual with Middle Eastern transliteration variants and real DOB or nationality evidence.

synthetic_transaction_recipe.recipe: Generate a related spelling for a synthetic student or family recipient with strongly conflicting age, nationality, and account KYC.

archetypes.title: Latin American Compound Surname and Gender Conflict

real_data_binding.selection_strategy: Bind a real OFAC individual with compound surname plus real gender and nationality evidence when available.

synthetic_transaction_recipe.recipe: Create a synthetic person whose name contains overlapping masculine/feminine tokens but conflicts on gender, surname structure, DOB, and passport.

real_data_binding.selection_strategy: Bind a real OFAC entity with a short distinctive token that can occur inside an ordinary recreational or family-remittance word.

synthetic_transaction_recipe.recipe: Embed the real token in a synthetic family-payment narrative and provide clean sender/recipient countries.

archetypes.title: Dual-Use Goods or Trade Serial Collision

real_data_binding.selection_strategy: Bind a real OFAC aircraft, vessel, or other asset with a real model, registration, or distinctive asset token.

synthetic_transaction_recipe.recipe: Reuse the exact token as a synthetic commercial product model or serial in an invoice narrative.

archetypes.title: Bankruptcy Trustee and Sanctioned Estate Name

real_data_binding.selection_strategy: Bind a real OFAC organization with a distinctive primary name.

synthetic_transaction_recipe.recipe: Embed the exact real name in a synthetic trustee, receiver, estate, or court-administrator account title and provide independent-control context.

archetypes.title: Short Exact Name versus Corporate Entity

real_data_binding.selection_strategy: Bind a real OFAC individual with a short two-token name and real person attributes.

synthetic_transaction_recipe.recipe: Use the exact name tokens as the root of a synthetic corporation with legal suffix, registry evidence, and distinct ownership.

archetypes.title: System Migration Padding or Technical Artifact

real_data_binding.selection_strategy: Bind a real OFAC entity with a real short alias; reject the binding when no eligible real alias exists.

synthetic_transaction_recipe.recipe: Insert the alias into a synthetic zero-padded migration, reconciliation, hash, or treasury-balancing reference.

real_data_binding.selection_strategy: Bind a real OFAC individual whose real surname or alias is also an ordinary dictionary or commercial word.

synthetic_transaction_recipe.recipe: Use the word only as a common noun in a synthetic goods or service description.

archetypes.title: Missing Qualifying Industry Word: Company versus Vessel

real_data_binding.selection_strategy: Bind a real OFAC vessel or maritime organization whose name contains a critical shipping, vessel, maritime, or transport qualifier.

synthetic_transaction_recipe.recipe: Retain the shared name root in a synthetic non-maritime business while omitting the real qualifying industry term and asset identifier.

archetypes.title: Distinctive Token with Multiple Missing Context Words

real_data_binding.selection_strategy: Bind a real OFAC bank or multi-token organization containing a distinctive token plus institution and country qualifiers.

synthetic_transaction_recipe.recipe: Use the distinctive token in a synthetic technology or service company while omitting the institution type and geographic qualifier.
